The words of a step, a case for each: a text written with the word any
old way, that text as it is laid out, the word written wrongly, and where
and why the reader refuses that. `WRITE_WORDS=1` on the test that reads
this writes what is laid out and what is refused, to be read before it is
kept.

=== step.again
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        again:   true
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    do: noop
    again: true
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        again: maybe
--- refused 5:16
`again` must be true or false

=== step.allow_failure
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        allow_failure: true
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    do: noop
    allow_failure: true
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        allow_failure: maybe
--- refused 5:24
`allow_failure` must be true or false

=== step.as
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        spawn: other
        as: kid
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    spawn: other
    as: kid
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        spawn: other
        as: [x]
--- refused 5:13
`as` must be text, found a list

=== step.environment
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        call: deploy
        environment: prod
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    call: deploy
    environment: prod
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        call: deploy
        environment: Prod Two
--- refused 5:22
`environment` names one of the project's environments: lowercase letters, digits and `-`, such as `prod`

=== step.do
--- written
blueprint: w

    a:
        do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: nothing.like.it
--- refused 3:5
there is no action called `nothing.like.it`

=== step.else
--- written
blueprint: w
permissions: [agents]
steps:
    a:
        do: fail
        if_fail_ask_agent: "@builder"
        else: broken
--- laid
blueprint: w
permissions: [agents]

steps:
  a:
    do: fail
    if_fail_ask_agent: "@builder"
    else: broken
--- wrong
blueprint: w
permissions: [agents]
steps:
    a:
        do: fail
        if_fail_ask_agent: "@builder"
        else: [a]
--- refused 7:15
`else` must be text, found a list

=== step.env

--- laid

  a:
    do: noop
    env: { A: b }
--- wrong
blueprint: w

    a:
        do: noop
        env: [a]
--- refused 5:14
`env` must be a mapping, found a list

=== step.for_each
--- written
blueprint: w
params:
    all: {type: list, default: [1]}
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        for_each: ${ params.all }
--- laid
blueprint: w

params:
  all: { type: list, default: [1] }

steps:
  a:
    do: noop
    for_each: ${params.all}
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        for_each: ${ 1 + }
--- refused 5:19
`for_each`: the expression ends too soon

=== step.if_fail_ask_agent
--- written
blueprint: w
permissions: [agents]
steps:
    a:
        do: fail
        if_fail_ask_agent: "@builder"
--- laid
blueprint: w
permissions: [agents]

steps:
  a:
    do: fail
    if_fail_ask_agent: "@builder"
--- wrong
blueprint: w
permissions: [agents]
steps:
    a:
        do: fail
        if_fail_ask_agent: [x]
--- refused 6:28
`if_fail_ask_agent` must be text, found a list

=== step.labels
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        call: other
        labels: {sort: plain}
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    call: other
    labels: { sort: plain }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        call: other
        labels: {kind: plain}
--- refused 5:18
`kind` cannot be a label: measurements already say that of themselves, and asked for `kind` could not say which was meant. Taken are: action, adapter, backend, blueprint, caller, collection, db, decision, device, extension, flow, handler, kind, method, name, op, project, route, router, service, slot, status, step, topic. Call it something else, such as `variant` or `experiment`

--- laid

  a:
    do: noop
    measure: w.build
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        measure: [a]
--- refused 5:18
`measure` must be text, found a list

=== step.needs
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        needs: []
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    do: noop
    needs: []
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        needs: [nobody]
--- refused 3:5
step `a` needs `nobody`, which is not a step here

=== step.on_fail
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        on_fail:
            - {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    do: noop
    on_fail:
      - { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        on_fail: 3
--- refused 5:18
a hook must be a mapping, found a number

=== step.retry
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        retry: {max: 2}
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    do: noop
    retry: { max: 2 }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        retry: lots
--- refused 5:16
`retry` must be a count or a mapping with `max` and `backoff`

=== step.timeout
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        timeout: 1m
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    do: noop
    timeout: 1m
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        timeout: soon
--- refused 5:18
`timeout`: `soon` is not a duration; write it like `30s` or `1h30m`

=== step.watch

        do: noop

--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a:
    do: noop
    watch:
      - { after: 1m, do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a:
        do: noop
        watch: 3
--- refused 5:16
`watch` must be a list of rules
